newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly up.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday, issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and they are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates were on a technical rebound after sharp falls in the past week due to a bank interest rate cut by the central bank on Friday last week.

Trading was active with both state-run commercial banks and provincial short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the People's Bank of China's, lending money, indicating short-term funds supply was sufficient, they said.
"There was a surplus of money on the market, with some banks, such as the Agricultural Bank of China, having more money to lend out due to seasonal reasons," one trader said.
